synthesis.main_claim: The authors propose an ongoing framework to quantify decentralization of governance power by analyzing governance token distributions in four DeFi applications using statistical dispersion coefficients.
synthesis.contribution: Offers a measurement-oriented approach to evaluate how concentrated or dispersed governance voting power is in blockchain-based financial applications.
synthesis.limitations: The paper is labeled research in progress; the supplied text presents an incomplete study with limited methodological detail and no full results section.
synthesis.use_in_review: Foundational/contextual reference only for broad governance-measurement ideas in financial technology; not usable as central or supporting evidence on conversational LLM governance, compliance, oversight, or operational controls.
